market: Global Reactive Polyurethane (PUR) Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesives market comprises solid isocyanate-terminated adhesives applied molten and then chemically cross-linked by moisture. It measures sales of finished PUR hot melts for lamination, assembly and edge-banding. BY PREPOLYMER BASE: Polyester-Based, Polyether-Based, Other Prepolymers. BY OPEN TIME: Short Open Time, Medium Open Time, Long Open Time. BY DELIVERY FORMAT: Cartridges, Drums & Pails, Slugs & Blocks. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Woodworking & Edge-Banding, Automotive Interiors, Textile & Footwear Lamination, Electronics Assembly, Building & Construction, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Non-reactive hot melts such as EVA, polyolefin, polyamide and polyester; moisture-cure one-component liquid polyurethane adhesives; polyurethane foam. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
